summary: This informational document specifies ways to interconnect multiple TRILL sites across an MPLS network using existing TRILL and VPLS standards. It addresses connecting more than two sites and keeping TRILL transparent across the MPLS network.

eli5.summary: Two playgrounds on different sides of a city can be joined by a hidden tunnel. This explains how to tunnel TRILL networks through an MPLS network.

questions: how to connect trill sites over mpls
